faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Science Education and Research Bhubaneswar (NISER) under an ANRF funded project in the School of Physical Sciences.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NISER?
faq.answer: NISER has advertised for the temporary position of Project Associate – I under the advertisement number NISER / R&D / PH2602 / 36 / 2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 temporary vacancy available for the Project Associate – I post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for NISER Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree in Physics from a recognized institute. Experience in device fabrication and superconductivity is desirable for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for the NISER Project Associate – I post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 50 years as on 05/10/2026. Candidates should verify their age according to the official guidelines provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for NISER Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: The salary is ₹37,000/- consolidated for candidates with CSIR-UGC NET/GATE, and ₹30,000/- consolidated for candidates without NET/GATE qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application by email?
faq.answer: The last date for sending the filled-in application along with scanned documents by email is 05-10-2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. When will the online interview take place?
faq.answer: The online interview through Google-meet for shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 07-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for NISER Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the designated email address ([email protected]).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of NISER?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the National Institute of Science Education and Research Bhubaneswar at www.niser.ac.in for further details.
